verdict.rationale: Word-level timestamps are a fair axis for a speech-to-text API, but no item in the pack documents per-word start/end times in Deepgram's transcription responses. The cited docs cover transcription endpoints, diarization, multichannel, smart formatting and callbacks, none of which mention word timing. The community report of an audio-search app returning wrong timestamps concerns search hits, not word-level transcript timing, so it does not count toward this story.
